Subject: Cross-border quarter-end: stage alignment & commit checkpoint

Team —

Quick request for the EMEA/APAC regional rollup: finance is finalising the Q4 committed forecast on Thursday 12/09 and wants the committed amounts to reconcile to HubSpot by EOD Tuesday 12/07. Please do the following for any deals where you are the primary AE or covering the account: 

- Confirm stage (Proposal, Negotiation, Contract) and update HubSpot if it’s changed in the last 7 days.
- For deals marked >=50% commit, add a one-line justification in the "Commit notes" field.
- Attach any outstanding SOW/Procurement docs to the HubSpot deal and ping finance if there are special billing/payment terms.

I attached the regional rollup (Q4-pipeline-rollup-EMEA.xlsx) with the rows I pulled today. Key items I flagged: ACME-DEAL-8721 shows as 65% but missing signed PO; please confirm status.

HubSpot link here for quick access: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/8721
Drive copy: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1AqEMEA-rollup-2027Q4

If you need me to run a short commit review for any top-5 deals, reply with 20 minutes that work and I’ll grab Marissa and Vivek.

Thanks —
Karthik
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Q4-pipeline-rollup-EMEA.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)

Karthik —

Thanks for the heads-up. Quick clarifications:

1) Treatment of trials/POC: if a POC has an executed MSA and the customer has committed to a pilot fee with payment terms in procurement, mark as "Contract" and include the PO/Invoice number in commit notes. If it’s an informal trial (no MSA), leave at "Negotiation" until signed.

2) Discounts in negotiation: Deals with any discount >15% need an explicit approval note from me or Vivek to be included in the committed amount. Otherwise, finance will model at list price.

I’ve updated the sheet for the five deals I own and added a short comment on ACME-DEAL-8721 (row 18). See attached extract.

Laura
Senior AE — EMEA
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Commit-log-2027Q4.csv (CSV excerpt, 8KB)
